title: Alectinib and SALL4-Targeted Fatty Acid Oxidation: A Strategy to Combat Oxaliplatin Resistance in Gastric Cancer.
authors: Xiao, Yangbin; Fang, Kaining; Liao, Jian; Zhou, Houwu; Zhu, Weidong; Liu, Zheng; Ouyang, Hui; Liu, Ke
journal: The Turkish journal of gastroenterology : the official journal of Turkish Society of Gastroenterology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究胃癌中SALL4通过脂肪酸氧化影响奥沙利铂耐药，并用分子对接验证药物与SALL4蛋白结合，但核心是肿瘤耐药机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅分子对接方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND/AIMS: Oxaliplatin is a frontline chemotherapeutic agent for gastric cancer (GC) patients; yet, its clinical efficacy is often hindered by drug resistance. Recent studies have suggested a link between fatty acid oxidation (FAO) in GC and chemoresistance, but the precise mechanisms remain elusive. MATERIALS AND METHODS: In this study, SALL4 was identified as a gene that is not only overexpressed in GC but also remarkably enriched in the FAO pathway through differential gene expression screening and gene set enrichment analysis. SALL4 could enhance the FAO process and oxaliplatin resistance in GC, as corroborated by western blot, assessment of FAO rates and adenosine triphosphate levels, and cell counting kit-8. RESULTS: Reversal experiments demonstrated that the small molecule drug Alectinib can counteract the promotion of FAO and oxaliplatin resistance by the upregulation of SALL4. The binding relationship between Alectinib and SALL4 protein was validated through molecular docking simulations and cellular thermal shift assay. CONCLUSION: This research has brought to light that Alectinib targets SALL4 to modulate the FAO process, thereby reducing the oxaliplatin resistance of GC cells. These findings may open up new avenues to tackle chemoresistance in GC.
abstract_zh: 背景/目的：奥沙利铂是胃癌（GC）患者的一线化疗药物；然而，其临床疗效常受耐药性阻碍。近期研究表明，胃癌中的脂肪酸氧化（FAO）与化疗耐药之间存在关联，但确切机制仍不明确。材料与方法：在本研究中，通过差异基因表达筛选和基因集富集分析，SALL4被鉴定为一个不仅在胃癌中过表达，而且在FAO通路中显著富集的基因。SALL4可增强胃癌中的FAO过程和奥沙利铂耐药性，这一点通过蛋白质印迹法、FAO速率和三磷酸腺苷水平评估以及细胞计数试剂盒-8得到证实。结果：逆转实验表明，小分子药物阿来替尼（Alectinib）能够抵消SALL4上调对FAO和奥沙利铂耐药的促进作用。通过分子对接模拟和细胞热位移分析，验证了阿来替尼与SALL4蛋白之间的结合关系。结论：本研究揭示，阿来替尼靶向SALL4以调节FAO过程，从而降低胃癌细胞对奥沙利铂的耐药性。这些发现可能为应对胃癌化疗耐药开辟新途径。
